abstract.para: &sudo; (Superuser Do) is a critical system administrative utility that allows permitted users to execute commands as a superuser or another user according to security policy. It forms a foundational component for privilege management, access control and audit logging in &suselinux; 16.

topic.para: The sudo package and its associated components follow the balanced lifecycle model. Packages are updated and maintained according to the following guidelines:

listitem.para: sudo is categorized under the balanced lifecycle model to strike an optimal balance between system stability and timely delivery of maintenance fixes, security hardening and upstream bug fixes.

varlistentry.term: Patch version updates per minor release

listitem.para: For every new &suselinux; 16 minor release, sudo is updated to a newer patch release version. This regular cadence delivers cumulative stability and security updates while preserving configuration and workflow compatibility.
